kurz: Zürcher Geschnetzeltes works when the meat is seared only briefly and goes back into the sauce right at the end.
bild_im_kopf: Like a guest who only turns up for dessert: if the meat goes into the sauce too early, it turns tough.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Pat the meat dry and sear it in batches in a very hot pan
schluesselmomente.warum: Too much meat at once cools the pan; it stews in its own juice and turns grey.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Take the meat out and sweat onions and mushrooms in the pan residue
schluesselmomente.warum: The brown roasted bits on the bottom of the pan are the base of the sauce.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Deglaze with white wine and reduce, then add cream
schluesselmomente.warum: Wine dissolves the residue; reducing concentrates the flavour.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Reduce the sauce until silky, then just warm the meat through in it
schluesselmomente.warum: Thin strips of meat cook through quickly. If they boil in the sauce, the fibres contract and turn dry.
